_read_me: The four service buttons under the home page hero (Elijah, November 13; built on eNov14, November 14).
title: the line above the buttons.

linkTo: "book" opens the booking form with that service (and config/booking-page.json bookLinks decides whether that is /book or in place); "page" links each button to its page instead (the service pages, once they exist).

Each button: label; image (one photo) or split (two photos, before then after, shown left and right); alt (what the photo shows, for screen readers and search); book (what the form starts with: intent "interior" or "exterior", or package or interest, a package id); page (where "page" mode links).
Photos come from Elijah's Drive folder "03 Website", resized into images/. Check every photo for plates, faces, house numbers and personal items first.
